estimated_minutes.assumption: about 20 seconds per item including the person's answer; Kolbe items run longer, instinct, chronotype and values items shorter. 155 items in all, 129 with every skip taken.

agent_style: One item at a time. Read the item, then the scale cue if the person hasn't used the scale on the last two answers.
Never explain or interpret an item; if asked, say: 'whatever it means to you, go with your first reaction.'
Accept a story answer, map it with the voice_answer_parser table, confirm in a few words, move on.
Each section has its own scale; read the scale cue at least once per section, and on the first item after any skip.

sections.intro: Hey {{name}}. This is the Soul Map interview. Seven parts, about fifty minutes, and you can stop and pick up any time, even days later. There are no right answers; go with your gut, and short answers are perfect. Ready?
Part one: what drives you. I'll say a sentence, and you tell me how true it is of you: not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely. First reaction is best.
sections.scale: Not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely?

checkpoint.rule: Run score_enneagram on the 27 answers so far. If confidence >= 0.6, skip the nine skip_if_confident items and ask only the disambiguation items whose pair are both in `contenders`. If confidence < 0.6, ask everything. Always ask the six instinct items.

sections.intro: Part two: how you connect with people, both close relationships and your team. Same scale: not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely.
sections.scale: Not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely?

checkpoint.rule: Run score_attachment on the 12 answers so far. If confidence >= 0.5, skip the four skip_if_confident items.

sections.intro: Part three: your everyday temperament. Short statements again, and the same scale: not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely. Answer for how you usually are, not your best day.
sections.scale: Not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely?

checkpoint.rule: Run score_bigfive on the 25 answers so far. For each domain with domain_confidence >= 0.7, skip that domain's skip_if_confident item; otherwise ask it.

sections.intro: Part four, a quick one: your body clock. Two questions about times, then a few statements. Imagine a completely free day: no work, no alarm, nobody to look after.
sections.scale: Clock time for the first two, then: not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely?

checkpoint.rule: Run score_chronotype on the 10 answers so far. If confidence >= 0.6, skip the two skip_if_confident items.

sections.intro: Part five: what matters to you. I'll describe a person. Tell me how much that person is like you. Six steps this time: not like me at all, not like me, a little like me, somewhat like me, like me, or very much like me.
sections.scale: Not like me at all, not like me, a little like me, somewhat like me, like me, or very much like me?

checkpoint.rule: Run score_values on all 21 answers. No skips: every value has only two items. If notes mention a flat profile, ask one follow-up: 'If you had to drop one of these from your life, which goes first?' and record it in the transcript, not the scores.

sections.intro: Part six: how you work best, after Peter Drucker's five questions: how you perform, how you learn, what you value, where you belong, and what you should contribute. Sixteen quick choices. A few ask you to recall a real moment first; picture it, then pick what actually happened, not what you think should be true. This tells your AI and your team how to brief you and what to hand you.

Last part: how you naturally create value. Twelve quick choices, four options each. Pick the one most like you, not the one you wish were true. This shows which kind of work, roles and money-making fit you, and which to hand to someone else.
That's everything. Your map is complete on screen, and your report and your soul file are ready to build. Thank you for being honest with it.
